posts.author: DarkAdria
posts.body:
Hello everyone.
I had some questions and wanted to see if anyone could answer them.
In my project I use the EnemyBook.js plugin that is by default in RPG Maker MV. The plugin is perfect (I love how it looks in the menu and the information it shows) except for two details.
The first is that enemies register in the bestiary when I first see them, instead of when I first defeat them. Is it possible to change that? Let them only register when they are defeated.
The second thing is that there is no way to "record" that the bestiary is complete. That is, if I want to create a character who will give you an item when you complete the bestiary, is it possible to do so? I haven't seen the way.
Could someone help me?
Thank you very much.
